NAME: PsiCauchy
NOTE: Quantile loc+scale*tan(pi*(u-0.5)). Frontline's own prose contradicts its signature about whether arg 1 is location or scale; the signature is authoritative.

NAME: PsiLaplace
NOTE: Quantile has a closed form in two branches around the median. Same prose/signature contradiction as PsiCauchy, in reverse.

NAME: PsiLevy
NOTE: Stable with alpha=1/2, beta=1. Heavy tailed; mean undefined.

NAME: PsiErlang
NOTE: Gamma with integer shape. Can delegate to this package's existing distributionGamma rather than be written fresh.

NAME: PsiFrechet
NOTE: Extreme value type II. scipy names it invweibull.

NAME: PsiMaxExtreme
NOTE: Gumbel, right-skewed.

NAME: PsiMinExtreme
NOTE: Gumbel, left-skewed. Distinct from PsiMaxExtreme; do not implement one and negate.

NAME: PsiLogLogistic
NOTE: scipy names it fisk. Note Frontline's argument order is location, scale, shape.

NAME: PsiInvNormal
NOTE: Inverse Gaussian, a.k.a. Wald. scipy's parameterisation differs from Frontline's; convert explicitly.

NAME: PsiNegBinomial
NOTE: Number of failures before the s-th success. Check which side Frontline counts.

NAME: PsiLogarithmic
NOTE: Logarithmic series, discrete.

NAME: PsiHypSecant
NOTE: Closed-form quantile: loc + scale*(2/pi)*ln(tan(pi*u/2)).

NAME: PsiFatigueLife
NOTE: Birnbaum-Saunders.

NAME: PsiReciprocal
NOTE: Log-uniform. scipy renamed reciprocal to loguniform.

NAME: PsiPearson5
NOTE: Pearson type V is the inverse gamma.

NAME: PsiPearson6
NOTE: Pearson type VI is the beta prime. Frontline documents PsiPearson6Alt with two parameters against this one's three; likely their error, recorded as published.

NAME: PsiBurr12
NOTE: Burr type XII.

NAME: PsiDagum
NOTE: Dagum is Burr type III. scipy's burr is type III and burr12 is type XII; confirm which shape maps to which before binding.

NAME: PsiKumaraswamy
NOTE: CDF on [0,1] is 1-(1-x^a)^b, quantile (1-(1-u)^(1/b))^(1/a), then scaled to [min,max]. No standard reference implementation needed.

NAME: PsiJohnsonSB
NOTE: Bounded Johnson.

NAME: PsiJohnsonSU
NOTE: Unbounded Johnson.

NAME: PsiDblTriang
NOTE: Two triangular pieces meeting at the mode, with p the probability mass below it.

NAME: PsiMyerson
NOTE: Three-point quantile-parameterised distribution. No standard library equivalent; the guide's definition is the only authority.

NAME: PsiMetalog
NOTE: Quantile-parameterised. Leading arguments are optional AND first, which needs care in any binding.

NAME: PsiMetalogFit
NOTE: Least-squares fit of metalog coefficients to data.

NAME: PsiCumul
NOTE: Piecewise-linear CDF through the given points.

NAME: PsiGeneral
NOTE: Piecewise-linear density through weighted points.

NAME: PsiDisUniform
NOTE: Uniform over an explicit set. Trivial over this package's existing uniform draw.

NAME: PsiShuffle
NOTE: Sampling without replacement — a permutation. Distinct from PsiResample, which is with replacement.

NAME: PsiMVLogNormal
NOTE: Delegate to this package's CorrelatedNormals and exponentiate.

NAME: PsiMomentFit
NOTE: Fits a distribution to four moments.

NAME: PsiAR1
NOTE: Time-series process, not an i.i.d. draw. PsiAR2, PsiMA1, PsiMA2, PsiARMA11 follow the same pattern and should share one implementation.

NAME: PsiGARCH11
SIGNATURE: mean, volatility, err_coef, ar_coef, val0, stdev0
NOTE: PsiARCH1, PsiEGARCH11 and PsiAPARCH11 are the same family. Lowest priority: 0 occurrences in the measured corpus.

NAME: PsiPoisson
NOTE: poissonCDF and the PMF exist here; a random draw does not. Add the sampler only.

NAME: PsiHyperGeo
NOTE: hypergeometric PMF exists here; a random draw does not.

NAME: PsiDiscrete
NOTE: meanDiscrete and varianceDiscrete exist; a draw from an explicit pmf does not.

NAME: LatinHypercube
NOTE: Stratified sampling. Frontline ships it; this package samples pseudo-randomly only.

NAME: Sobol
NOTE: CRITICAL: Sobol sequences differ between implementations by their direction numbers. State which set is used, or results are unreproducible against any other tool.

NAME: Halton
NOTE: Note whether scrambling is applied; unscrambled Halton correlates badly in high dimensions.

NAME: ImportanceSampling
NOTE: Requires a proposal distribution and weight bookkeeping in SimulationResults.

NAME: RATE
NOTE: Solves the annuity identity for the rate. Iterative; Excel's own default guess is 10%.

NAME: NPER
NOTE: Closed form from the same identity.

NAME: PDURATION
NOTE: ln(fv/pv)/ln(1+rate).

NAME: NOMINAL
NOTE: Inverse of EFFECT, which exists here as DebtInstrument.effectiveAnnualRate.

NAME: SLN
NOTE: Straight-line exists only inside RealEstateModel and BusinessMathDSL. Needs a general form.

NAME: DDB
NOTE: Double-declining balance, factor defaulting to 2.

NAME: SYD
NOTE: Sum-of-years-digits.

NAME: VDB
NOTE: Variable declining balance, switching to straight-line unless told not to.

NAME: ACCRINT
SIGNATURE: issue, first_interest, settlement, rate, par, frequency, [basis]
NOTE: Accrued interest. Depends on DayCountConvention, which exists here.
